text:
European football serves up a fascinating slate this weekend, with the model finding several sharp disagreements against the market across Spain, Italy, France, and England.

The strongest contrast comes in La Liga, where the model gives Osasuna a 44.1% chance to beat Athletic Bilbao, well above Bet365's 27.8% implied chance at odds of 3.6. In Serie A, the model views Atalanta as emphatic 70.5% favourites away to Monza, whereas Bet365 sits at 48.8% with odds of 2.05. 

A few underdogs also warrant a closer look. Bet365 prices Getafe at 8.0 (a 12.5% chance) away to Villarreal, while the model rates their winning hopes at 18.0%. In Ligue 1, Auxerre are priced at 4.33 (23.1%) against Paris FC, but the model estimates their chance at 33.2%. Across the Channel, Crystal Palace are offered at 5.5 (18.2%) at home to Liverpool, with the model projecting a 25.9% probability. Because the model has historically proven slightly less accurate than Bet365, these divergences should be seen as areas of curiosity rather than certainties.

Looking back at the latest round, accuracy is tracked through log loss, where a lower score indicates better overall forecasting. The model scored a notable success in Ligue 1 by backing Lille to beat Lens with a 47.8% win chance while Bet365 favoured the away side. In the Bundesliga, the model also proved sharper on Werder Bremen's 2-0 win over Hoffenheim, where the bookmaker had favoured the visitors.

Both forecasters were caught out by major upsets, however. Elversberg's 4-1 rout of Mainz delivered the week's biggest shock, punishing the model's 76.0% confidence in an away win. Unpredicted away victories for Brighton at Manchester City and Parma at Atalanta also proved costly to both predictive sheets.
